passages.text: “Even in this life they have conquered the round of birth and death whose minds are firm-fixed on the sameness of everything, for God is pure and the same to all, and therefore such are said to be living in God.”
passages.note: Equanimity; seeing all things as equal brings freedom

passages.text: “Everything in this life is fraught with fear. It is renunciation alone that makes one fearless.”
passages.note: Fear, and letting go as the way to fearlessness
